activities.summary: Sourced from BDL bank list. Named Chairman/CEO/main shareholder Antoun Sehnaoui. Group includes Fidus Wealth Management arm, worth separate note. Resolution-track status not publicly confirmed.

description: Major Lebanese universal bank (founded 1953), retail, corporate and private banking, part of the SGBL Group alongside Société Générale de Banque en Jordanie (SGBJ) and a wealth-management arm, Fidus Wealth Management. Chairman, CEO and main shareholder: Antoun Sehnaoui.

fit.reasoning: Fit: bank segment (20) + Lebanon (15) + multi-asset via group wealth-management arm Fidus (10) + third-party deposits and private wealth clients (10) + BDL regulated (5) = 60/60. Timing: sector-wide pressure only (10/25) - no bank-specific viability confirmation, gating question unresolved. Access: named Chairman/CEO/main shareholder (Antoun Sehnaoui) is a well-documented public figure, improving reachability odds even without a direct route = 5/15. Total mechanically ~75, held to 53 pending viability-track confirmation. The Fidus Wealth Management arm is worth a separate look if SGBL clears the resolution question - closer to our family-office/private-banking pitch than the retail bank itself.
